source_of_truth: transcribed from the released scripts (src/rate_analysis/r4_stageA.py, fit_priorities.py, build_Z.py, rate_primary.R); the scripts govern
dataset_filter: clinical_and_imaging_info.xlsx rows with dataset == 'ISPY2', matching her2 value, non-missing pcr; workbook row order = analysis-frame order
treatment: T = 1 if nac_agent != control arm of the cohort, else 0

split.rule: numpy.random.default_rng(42).permutation(n); first ceil(n/2) indices -> train (H1), remainder -> evaluation (H2); Y and T not used; no stratification

enrolment_epochs.rule: boundaries at the first observed acquisition date and the day after the last observed date of every experimental arm (all nac_agent values except the two control arms); populated intervals numbered chronologically; 22 epochs

effect_modifiers_X.encoding: sklearn LabelEncoder on the string levels (frozen); StandardScaler fitted on the training half
effect_modifiers_X.imaging_preprocessing: StandardScaler then PCA(k, random_state=42), both fitted on the training half only (regime A)

nuisance_covariates_W: 22 relative-enrolment epoch indicators (one-hot of the regenerated epoch assignment), omitted in the no-epoch sensitivity

prioritization_model.model_t: RandomForestClassifier(same hyperparameters); RandomForestRegressor with discrete_treatment=False in the alternative treatment-nuisance sensitivity

evaluation_covariates_Z.definition: imaging-free; age (+ missingness indicator), hr, mammaprint, ethnicity one-hot, bmi_group one-hot, menopause one-hot ('pre' variants merged), epoch one-hot from a fixed 22-level basis

evaluation_forest.call: causal_forest(X = Z, Y, W = T, num.trees = 2000, seed = 42) on the evaluation half only

rate.bootstrap: half-sample bootstrap, R = 2000, set.seed(20260906) before every call
rate.multiplicity: Holm across the six Q1 tests; none for the single Q2 primary contrast

sequential_sensitivity.rule: fit on folds 1..k-1, evaluate on fold k, k = 2..5
